answer: Reputation decay for idle identities: standing loses 12 percent an epoch without a graded submission, and any identity-link attempt resets it to zero. Duplicates are caught by replay, so renaming buys nothing. Cost: a clone parked for 6 epochs is at 46 percent standing, and a comet of activity after that restores it slowly. The harbor of fresh accounts is shallow, and the nadir arrives when grading seats demand a past-epoch record the clone never built.
